editor.purpose: CodeMirror source editing and inline code contexts.

ui.purpose: Document names, search, and title-bar chrome.

label.purpose: Controls, counts, metadata, and status text.

shadows.name: floating-light
shadows.purpose: Elevates the formatting shelf, command palette, and toast in light appearance.

shadows.name: floating-dark
shadows.purpose: Elevates the same floating affordances in dark appearance.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Separates the compact-screen document drawer from its scrim.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared deceleration for shell, shelf, palette, toast, and drawer motion.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Hover, color, opacity, and press feedback on controls.

motion.name: rail
motion.purpose: Desktop grid-column changes when rails open or close.

motion.name: overlay-entry
motion.purpose: Command-palette entry from a small upward offset and scale.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Effectively disables animation and transition when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Save Button
components.description: Compact graphite primary action with saved and unsaved icon feedback.
components.css: .ds-save-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--ink-strong, #15171a); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); font: 650 11px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-save-button svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-save-button:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-save-button:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-save-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0878e6) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Neutral native-radius utility control used throughout the shell.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="打开菜单"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h16"/><path d="M4 12h16"/><path d="M4 19h16"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #626b75); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: var(--hover, rgba(30, 36, 44, 0.055)); color: var(--ink-strong, #15171a); } .ds-icon-button:active { background: var(--pressed, rgba(30, 36, 44, 0.09)); transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0878e6) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Icon Button
components.description: Selected utility control with the restrained quiet-blue state wash.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button-active" type="button" aria-pressed="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h16"/><path d="M4 12h16"/><path d="M4 19h16"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button-active { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--accent-soft, #dceeff); color: var(--accent-ink, #075aa8); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-icon-button-active svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-icon-button-active:hover { color: var(--ink-strong, #15171a); } .ds-icon-button-active:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-icon-button-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0878e6) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: View Switcher
components.description: Segmented Edit, Read, and Split modes with a paper-selected state.
components.css: .ds-view-switcher { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 34px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dde1e6); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--app-ground, #f4f5f7); } .ds-view-switcher button { height: 26px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #626b75); font: 400 11px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-view-switcher button:hover { color: var(--ink, #202329); } .ds-view-switcher button.ds-active { background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--ink-strong, #15171a); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(20, 26, 33, 0.12); font-weight: 620; } .ds-view-switcher button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0878e6) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Library Search
components.description: Quiet inset search field for filtering local Markdown documents.
components.html: <label class="ds-library-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.34-4.34"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="搜索" aria-label="搜索文稿" /></label>
components.css: .ds-library-search { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; width: 224px; height: 34px; padding: 0 7px 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dde1e6); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--paper-subtle, #fafbfc); color: var(--muted, #626b75); } .ds-library-search svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-library-search input { min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #202329); font: 400 13px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-library-search input::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #626b75); } .ds-library-search:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0878e6) 62%, var(--line, #dde1e6)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0878e6) 15%, transparent); }

components.name: Active Document Row
components.description: Current-document navigation row with restrained paper lift and strong naming.
components.css: .ds-document-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr) 14px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 232px; padding: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--accent, #0878e6); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 26, 32, 0.045); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-document-row > span:nth-child(2) { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-document-row strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink-strong, #15171a); font: 630 13px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-document-row small { color: var(--faint, #626b75); font: 400 10px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-document-row:hover { background: var(--paper, #ffffff); } .ds-document-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0878e6) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Formatting Shelf
components.description: Signature edit-only floating shelf for contextual Markdown formatting.
components.css: .ds-format-shelf { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--shelf, #25282d); color: var(--shelf-ink, #f4f5f6); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 14px 36px rgba(21, 27, 34, 0.16), 0 2px 7px rgba(21, 27, 34, 0.1)); } .ds-format-shelf button { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 31px; height: 31px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 600 12px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-format-shelf > span { width: 1px; height: 18px; margin: 0 3px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--shelf-ink, #f4f5f6) 18%, transparent); } .ds-format-shelf button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--shelf-ink, #f4f5f6) 12%, transparent); } .ds-format-shelf button:active { transform: scale(0.9); } .ds-format-shelf button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0878e6) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Command Palette
components.description: Keyboard-first paper overlay for progressively disclosed commands.
components.css: .ds-command-palette { width: min(540px, calc(100vw - 30px)); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cfd4da); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #202329); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 14px 36px rgba(21, 27, 34, 0.16), 0 2px 7px rgba(21, 27, 34, 0.1)); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-command-palette > label { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 23px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 52px; padding: 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dde1e6); color: var(--muted, #626b75); } .ds-command-palette svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-command-palette input { min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-strong, #15171a); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; } .ds-command-palette kbd { color: var(--faint, #626b75); font: 400 10px/1.35 inherit; } .ds-command-palette > div { padding: 7px; } .ds-command-palette button { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #626b75); font: 400 12px/1.35 inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-command-palette button:hover, .ds-command-palette button.ds-suggested { background: var(--accent-soft, #dceeff); color: var(--accent-ink, #075aa8); } .ds-command-palette button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0878e6) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
PatchMark should feel less like opening software and more like returning to a finished page on a cool, carefully lit writing desk. The document is the visual center of gravity: chrome is compact, rails are tonal rather than boxed, and controls wait at the edges until the writer needs them.

The system combines cool paper surfaces, graphite text, hairline structure, quiet blue state feedback, and familiar native proportions. Restraint is functional rather than empty: reading receives an editorial serif voice, editing receives a precise mono voice, and the surrounding interface stays in a quiet system sans.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous writing plane, never a dashboard or card grid.
Cool neutral surfaces with graphite ink and a single quiet-blue interaction voice.
Native-radius controls, dense desktop chrome, and generous document breathing room.
Serif reading, monospaced source editing, and sans-serif interface chrome.
Progressive disclosure through rails, a command palette, focus mode, and the floating formatting shelf.

rules.name: The Quiet Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue appears only for current, selected, focused, linked, or unsaved state; it never becomes a large decorative field.

rules.name: The Paper Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with cool neutral tone and hairlines before introducing containers, cards, or shadow.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif belongs to rendered prose, mono belongs to source editing, and system sans belongs to interface chrome and rendered headings.

rules.name: The Reading Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Long-form content keeps a relaxed line height and a centered measure; compact UI type must not leak into the document.

rules.name: The Document Is the Surface Rule
rules.body: Start every composition from the continuous writing plane; rails and controls support it but never replace it with dashboard scaffolding.

rules.name: The 720 Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep reading and source content centered within the implemented 720px measure; use split view to divide work modes, not to stretch prose.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: A shadow must correspond to selected state or physical overlay; static content and structural rails stay flat.

rules.name: The Native Radius Rule
rules.body: Radius follows scale and function; never round every surface into a capsule, and never use cards merely to create corners.

dos: Do begin with a readable document and reveal navigation or formatting controls only when the task calls for them.
Do use quiet blue exclusively for interaction state, selection, links, caret, and trustworthy save feedback.
Do preserve the serif/mono/sans division between reading, source editing, and chrome.
Do keep desktop controls compact while expanding interactive targets to at least 44px below the compact breakpoint.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences by collapsing animations and transitions to effectively instantaneous feedback.
donts: Don't turn the home surface into a dashboard, permanent toolbar, card grid, or configuration gate.
Don't stretch prose beyond the centered 720px measure or use wide lines to fill available space.
Don't introduce extra accent hues, decorative gradients, or broad blue panels.
Don't apply strong shadow to static rails, document content, or ordinary controls.
Don't compress split view or the outline into narrow screens; resolve to the simpler reading plane.
